title: State — traffic light cycle (Javascript)
description: State objects encapsulate per-state behavior; the context delegates and transitions by swapping the state object. Switch statements on state melt away.
how_it_works: Each state knows its successor; the loop just follows next pointers.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Shared mutable state objects cause spooky cross-talk — keep them stateless or clone.
